subject: general
question: Name the strait which separates Tamil Nadu of India and Mannar of Sri Lanka.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Palk strait.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Palk Strait** is a body of water that separates the southeastern coast of **Tamil Nadu** in India from the **Mannar** region of **Sri Lanka**.
 
• It is approximately **40-85 kilometers** wide, connecting the Bay of Bengal to the Gulf of Mannar.
 
• The strait is named after the ancient **Palk Bay**, a shallow bay located to the east of the strait.
 
• Palk Strait is significant for regional trade, fishing, and has a rich marine biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographical Importance**: The Palk Strait serves as a crucial shipping route for vessels traveling to and from the ports of India and Sri Lanka.
 
• **Historical Context**: The strait has historical significance as it is believed to have been crossed by Lord Rama during the epic Ramayana, leading to the construction of the **Ram Setu** or Adam's Bridge.
 
• **Environmental Concerns**: The Palk Strait is home to various marine species, including endangered species like the dugong. Conservation efforts are essential to protect this biodiversity.
 
• **Disputes and Agreements**: There have been discussions and disputes over fishing rights and maritime boundaries in the Palk Strait, necessitating bilateral agreements between India and Sri Lanka.
